caseNameFull: Choctaw Nation v. Oklahoma and Cherokee Nation or Tribe of Indians in Oklahoma v. Oklahoma
attorneys: Charles A. Hobbs for Wilkinson, Cragun & Barker on its motion in both cases. J. D. McLaughlin for petitioners in No. 41 and Peyton Ford for petitioner in No. 59 in opposition. Solicitor General Griswold on his motion in both cases.

opinions.text: [Certiorari granted, 394 U. S. 972.] Motion of Wilkinson, Cragun & Barker for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae granted and 20 minutes allotted for that purpose. Twenty additional minutes allotted to counsel for respondents.
